title: 无声诗史 (Wusheng shishi / Silent History of Poetry)
author: 姜绍书 (Jiang Shaoshu)
citation_detail: 7卷 (7 juan). Standard edition: 于安澜编《画史丛书》, 上海人民美术出版社, 1963. Also: 四库全书存目丛书 子部第72册, 齐鲁书社, 1997. Covers Ming dynasty painters in biographical format, roughly chronological. Compiled ~120 years after Qiu Ying's death from earlier sources and transmitted knowledge.
note: Early Qing painting history; one of the most important compilations of Ming painter biographies. Near-contemporary source for late Ming painters. Discusses Qiu Ying's background (commoner origin, lacquer work), teacher Zhou Chen, and exceptional copying skill. Added in source verification sprint v2 (2026-05-12). Specific juan/page references for Qiu Ying entry need passage-level verification.

title: 明画录 (Ming hualu / Records of Ming Painting)
author: 徐沁 (Xu Qin)
citation_detail: 8卷 (8 juan). Standard edition: 于安澜编《画史丛书》, 上海人民美术出版社, 1963. Also: 续修四库全书 子部第1065册. Organized by painting category (道释, 人物, 宫室, 山水 etc.). Professional painters section covers Qiu Ying.
note: Early Qing painting history; organizes Ming painters by genre. Professional painters section includes Qiu Ying with discussion of his gongbi technique, architectural painting, and copying ability. One of the earliest systematic sources for Ming painting categories. Added in source verification sprint v2 (2026-05-12). Specific juan/page/entry references need passage-level verification.

title: 图绘宝鉴续编 (Tuhui baojian xubian / Continued Precious Mirror of Painting)
author: 韩昂 (Han Ang)
citation_detail: 1卷 (1 juan). Compiled 正德十四年 (Zhengde 14, 1519 CE). Standard edition: 四库全书本 (Siku quanshu edition). Also in 于安澜编《画史丛书》, 上海人民美术出版社, 1963. Continues 夏文彦《图绘宝鉴》(1365); covers Ming painters from Hongwu to Zhengde periods.
note: Compiled in 1519 during Qiu Ying's early career (he was ~25 if born ca. 1494). Covers Ming painters up to the Zhengde period. Qiu Ying's inclusion is uncertain given his career peaked in the Jiajing period (1522–1566); the 续编 is cited primarily for its documentation of Zhou Chen, Qiu Ying's teacher, and the broader Suzhou professional painting tradition. Primary value: near-contemporary source for the artistic milieu Qiu Ying entered. Added in source verification sprint v2 (2026-05-12). Whether it contains a Qiu Ying entry needs passage-level verification.
